title: Azure.Messaging.EventHubs
description: Ingest and process large streams of events from Azure Event Hubs.

data.text: `Azure.Messaging.EventHubs` is the modern SDK for Azure Event Hubs. It is designed for high-throughput event streaming scenarios like IoT telemetry, log aggregation, and real-time analytics.
Use `EventHubProducerClient` to create and send batches of events to an Event Hub.

data.title: Send and Receive Events

terms.definition: Sends batches of events to an Event Hub.
Reads events from partitions within an Event Hub.
A view of an Event Hub that lets multiple readers consume independently.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `EventDataBatch` to group events efficiently and stay within size limits.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Event Hubs is built for high-throughput event streaming.
Producers send batches; consumers read from partitions.
Consumer groups allow independent reading of the same event stream.
data.takeaway: Azure.Messaging.EventHubs is the standard SDK for real-time event ingestion in .NET.

data.title: Exercise: Send a Batch of Events
data.description: Create a console app that sends five events to an Event Hub and prints one received event.
steps: Create an EventHubProducerClient and send a batch.
Create an EventHubConsumerClient and read one event.
Print the event body and properties.
data.expectedOutcome: You understand the basic Event Hubs producer and consumer workflow.
